ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation occupies approximately 95% of the fluke surface area. High-contrast white geometric blobs are present as small, discrete circular points scattered across both lobes, with larger, irregular contiguous white masses localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with well-defined interior vertices.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges exhibit low-amplitude, undulating topography; distal trailing edges exhibit high-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys concentrated near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong convex curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges exhibit an upward concave sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of approximately 50-60 small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters scattered across the dark background of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular high-intensity white scarring and jagged tissue at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'starfield' pattern of white punctate marks localized predominantly on the posterior half of the ventral surface.
